solver.kind: blind AI solver (separate agent, answer-free packet, rubric v2)

E021-01.notes: No punctuation between subject 'a high school junior named Dana Ruiz' and verb 'helped'; comma, semicolon and lone dash all split subject from verb.

E021-02.notes: Contrast between small range and large population needs 'but'. 'so'/'and so' imply cause; 'for' makes the population the reason for the short signal.

E021-03.notes: Relative pronoun is the subject of 'had planned', so 'who'; 'whom' is object case, 'which' is for things, 'whose' is possessive.

E021-05.notes: The announcement hour is itself a program on the station, so the comparison must exclude it: 'any other program'. A and B illogically compare it to itself; D ('all programs') implies combined listenership. NO CHANGE sounds natural, so most quick solvers keep it.

E021-06.notes: Nonessential participial phrase 'running on a generator' needs a closing comma to match the opening one. B leaves it unbalanced; C semicolon creates a fragment; D 'and became' leaves no main verb paired correctly.

flags: minor: C ('days, one after the other') is wordy but not strictly redundant on its own; B is clearly the most concise, so the key holds, though a few test-takers may argue B loses the 'consecutive' idea.
E021-07.notes: 'consecutive' and 'in a row' are redundant; 'For three days' is concise and the continuity is clear from context.

flags: minor: context (only commissioners can vote funds) makes 'they' resolvable, so some may defend A; standard ACT pronoun-ambiguity convention supports C.
E021-08.notes: 'they' could refer to commissioners or volunteers; naming 'the commissioners' removes ambiguity. 'it' disagrees in number; 'those' is vague.

E021-09.notes: Call-letter detail is irrelevant to the storm/generator paragraph. A and B are unsupported; C claims a nonexistent contradiction.

E021-10.notes: Essay shows the station becoming the community bulletin board and the sole news source during the storm. B (licensing detail) isn't in the essay; C misstates focus; D is irrelevant to whether it serves its community.
